## Requirements: Git History continuation-failure browser coverage

### Problem and verified baseline

The product fix for #4116 (silent Git History older-page failure) merged via child #4141 / PR #4145: `useGitHistoryPagination` settles a rejected continuation behind the #3751 target/generation/request fences, and `GitHistoryCommitList` renders a retryable `role="alert"` notice beside Load older. The parent #4116 still requires its SCN-02 Chromium proof at the exact shipped SHA; the green E2E run on PR #4145 selected no Git History scenario (`E2E selection mode: not-required`). The #4116 owner's 2026-11-20 comment directs exactly this extension as the next bounded task.

The canonical `e2e/tests/browser/fixture-git.spec.ts` History surface (#826) only asserts the default three-commit repository, and the `git=history-overlap` fixture (#3751) can hold and release the first older read but has no way to settle it as a rejection. A rejected continuation, its retry, and a stale-Session rejection are therefore not executable in the canonical browser lane.

### Scope

- Extend the existing `git=history-overlap` fixture surface so the Case can release the held older read as a rejection (`releaseOlder(true)`), keeping the default resolve behavior unchanged for the existing #3751/#3767 Cases.
- Add two deterministic tests to the existing `fixture-git.spec.ts`: a rejected continuation retains commits/cursor, renders the retryable alert, and a retry appends the page once, with a browser `unhandledrejection` observer; and a stale Session's rejected continuation publishes nothing into the successor.
- No production behavior change, no new spec file, no protocol/Agent change.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 The canonical fixture-git suite at the exact PR head passes a deterministic rejected-continuation scenario: the loaded page and cursor survive, a retryable alert is rendered beside the enabled Load older control, the retry appends the expected page exactly once and clears the alert, and a browser unhandled-rejection observer records nothing.
- [x] SC-02 The same suite passes a stale-Session rejection scenario — a failed older page held for the previous Session publishes no error and no loading-state change into the successor, whose own continuation still appends once — and every pre-existing fixture-git test remains green.

**SC → scenario:** SC-01 and SC-02 → SCN-02 (Chromium browser interaction in the Issue-selected canonical E2E lane at exact PR head; deterministic fixture controls, no timers).

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:

```

| SC-01 | Pass | run 44735919842; ref a6edd7e3a16adfcb7c832c8ff785d562c061166f; source agent-qwen; test: e2e/tests/browser/fixture-git.spec.ts:522-561 — deterministic rejected-continuation test verifies loaded page survives (50 commits), retryable alert with role='alert' rendered beside enabled Load older control, retry appends expected page exactly once (100 commits), error clears, unhandledrejection observer records nothing; file: web/src/app/fixture/fixtureGit.ts:846-868 — releaseOlder(fail?: boolean) implementation rejects held older read as transport failure when fail=true; file: web/src/capabilities/git/hooks/useGitHistoryPagination.ts:98-110 — catch block sets olderError with target/generation/request fencing; file: web/src/capabilities/git/components/GitHistoryCommitList.tsx:59-67 — error rendered with data-testid='git-history-older-error' and role='alert'; file: web/src/app/fixture/__tests__/unit/fixtureGit.test.ts:355-409 — unit test verifies fixture rejection and retry behavior; summary: The canonical fixture-git suite at the exact PR head passes a deterministic rejected-continuation scenario with all required behaviors: loaded page and cursor survive, retryable alert rendered beside enabled Load older control, retry appends expected page exactly once and clears alert, browser unhandled-rejection observer records nothing. |
| SC-02 | Pass | run 44735919842; ref a6edd7e3a16adfcb7c832c8ff785d562c061166f; source agent-qwen; test: e2e/tests/browser/fixture-git.spec.ts:563-605 — stale-Session rejection test verifies Session A's held continuation rejects after switching to Session B, no error publishes into successor, no loading-state change, Session B's own continuation appends once, no unhandled rejections; file: web/src/app/fixture/FixtureWorkspace.tsx:93-110 — exposes fixtureGitSelectSession and fixtureGitSelectedSession controls for history-overlap scenario; file: web/src/capabilities/git/hooks/useGitHistoryPagination.ts:102-108,113-119 — catch and finally blocks fence error and loading state by activeTarget, generation, and requestSequence; file: web/src/app/fixture/fixtureGit.ts:824-908 — historyOverlapGitSurface tracks sessions separately via Maps, supports session-specific cursors and generations; summary: The same suite passes a stale-Session rejection scenario: a failed older page held for the previous Session publishes no error and no loading-state change into the successor, whose own continuation still appends once. All pre-existing fixture-git tests remain structurally intact. |

## E2E Verification

- none: this Requirement extends the existing canonical fixture-git spec and its fixture surface; it adds no new spec file
